Scheme: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre-matric Scholarship to Other Backward Classes (OBC) for Studies in India
Section: Application Process
Mode: Online
Steps:
**Step 1:** Visit the [National Scholarship Portal](http://www.scholarships.gov.in/). Here, you should click on the "New Registration" option. This will lead you to a set of guidelines for registration. Please scroll down to read the undertaking carefully. After understanding and accepting the terms, click on "Continue."

**Step 2:** A registration form will appear. In this form, you'll notice that some fields are marked with an asterisk (*), indicating that they are mandatory. Fill in the required details and then click "Register." Your unique Application ID and password will be displayed on the screen, and you'll also receive this information via SMS on your registered mobile number.

**Step 3:** Proceed to the "[New Registration](https://scholarships.gov.in/fresh/newstdRegfrmInstruction)" page. Here, select "Login to Apply" and provide your Application ID and password. Enter the CAPTCHA code to confirm your identity, and then click "Login." You'll be asked to enter an OTP sent to your registered mobile number. After this, you'll be directed to a page where you can reset your password. Create a new password, confirm it, and click "Submit." This will lead you to the "Applicant’s Dashboard."

**Step 4:** On the left side of the "Applicant's Dashboard," you'll find an option labelled "Application Form." Remember, the fields marked with an asterisk (*) are mandatory. Fill in the required information and make sure to upload the necessary documents. You have the choice to "Save as Draft" if you wish to complete the application at a later time, or you can select "Final Submit" to submit the application right away.

Section: Application Process
Mode: Offline
Steps:
> **Nomination for Award:**

**Step 01:** Advertisement for the award shall be uploaded every year in January on the [Department Website](https://sports.odisha.gov.in/) with a prescribed application format which will be also available in the office of District Collector & DSO, Supdt. of Police, NYKS, NSS, BSG, NCC, IRCS & Sports & Youth Services Department.
**Step 02:** The nominations can be sent by the Collector, Supdt. of Police, DSO, NYKS, NSS, BSG, the person himself/herself, any registered Voluntary Organization, NCC & Indian Red-Cross Society (State or Central Branch) to the Secretary, Odisha State Youth Welfare Board, C-1, Nayapalli, Unit-8, Bhubaneswar.
**Note 01:** Department of Sports & Youth Services/can also suo motu nominate names for the award.

**Note 01:** Department of Sports & Youth Services/can also suo motu nominate names for the award.

> **Scrutiny & Selection:**

- Scrutiny and selection will be done by a three-member Committee chaired by Commissioner-cum-Secretary, Sports & Youth Services Department with Asst. Director, Y.S. and AFA-cum-Under-Secretary of the Department as members.
 - Recommendation of the Committee will be sent to Hon'ble Minister, Sports & Youth Services for Government approval.

> **Timelines for the Award:**

 - Invitation of application/nomination through issue of advertisement: by 31st January
 - Last date for receipt of application/nomination: by 31st March
 - Scrutiny & selection: by 31st May
 - Award Ceremony: by 29th August (National Sports Day)

Scheme: Balika Samrithi Yojana
Section: Application Process
Mode: Offline
Steps:
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the [Office/ Sub-Office](https://wcd.py.gov.in/office-locations) of the Department of Women and Child Development, and request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
OR
The interested applicant should take print of the prescribed format of the application form.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).

**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Deputy Director (Women Development) or the Child Development Project Officer (depending on the location), at least 30 days before the proposed marriage date.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

Scheme: Balika Samrithi Yojana
Section: Application Process
Mode: Online
Steps:
**Step 1:** Visit the [Official Website](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/) of the e-District Portal of the Government of Puducherry.
**Step 2:** At the top right corner of the home page, click "[Login](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/Login.aspx)". In the login screen, click "[Register a New Membership](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/User/Registration.aspx)".
**Step 3:** On the Registration Page, fill in all the mandatory fields: Username, Password, Confirm Password, Personal Details (Full Name, First Name, Email Address, Address, Current Address, Gender, Date of Birth, Mobile Number). Agree to the declaration. Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Signup".

**Step 4:** Visit the [Official Website](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/) of the e-District Portal of the Government of Puducherry.
**Step 5:** At the top right corner of the home page, click "[Login](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/Login.aspx)". In the login screen, provide your Username and Password, fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Sign In".
**Step 6:** On the next screen, a list of schemes by the Government of Puducherry will be displayed Department-wise.
**Step 7:** Click on the scheme you wish to apply for. You will be taken to its online application form.
**Step 8:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields (marked with a red asterisk) and upload all the mandatory documents (self-attest if required).

**Step 9:** Tick the declaration stating "I hereby declare that the above-mentioned details are true and correct as per the best of my Knowledge". Submit the application and note the application number for [tracking your application](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/User/TrackApplication.aspx). The application number will also be received on your Registered Mobile Number / Registered Email ID.
***Track Your Application** [here](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/User/TrackApplication.aspx)
*** Access the User Manual for Online Application** [here](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/Help.rar)

Scheme: Divyang Shiksha Protsahan Yojana
Section: Application Process
Mode: Offline
Steps:
**Step 1:** Applicants can apply for the scheme using the prescribed format and submitting the necessary documents either to the designated officer's office, the Gram Panchayat, or a Public Service Center.
**Step 2:** Upon submitting a complete application, the applicant will receive a mandatory acknowledgment from the office.
**Step 3**: The District Panchayat/Gram Panchayat/Urban Body/Ward Office will scrutinize the documents submitted with the application.
**Step 4**: If, after investigation, the documents are found to be incorrect according to the rules, the application will be rejected with written explanation.

**Step 5**: If, after investigation, the documents are found to be correct, the pension case will be approved according to the rules.
**Step 6:** Once the pension is approved, the beneficiary's name will be added to the pension proposal for the current month by the District Panchayat/Gram Panchayat/Urban Body/Ward Office. The approved order will be maintained on record.
**Step 7**: The Directorate will deposit the monthly pension amount directly into the beneficiary's bank savings account through a single click, starting from the same month the approval is granted.

Scheme: Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers for Installation of Submersible / Centrifugal Motor Pumpsets With Accessories
Section: Application Process
Mode: Offline
Steps:
**Step 1:** The applicant must obtain the mandatory PERMIT for the construction of a new / replacement tubewell from the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry.
**Step 2:** The applicant of the Puducherry region should approach the concerned office towards the construction of the tubewell by deploying departmental machinery. The applicants who want to construct the tubewell through private machinery should approach the concerned office to get NOC.

**Step 3:** After obtaining NOC, the farmer has to construct a tubewell by deploying private machinery which is registered with Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry. Inspection will be conducted by the Agricultural Officer (Engg.) concerned at the time of the construction of the tubewell to ascertain the details of pipes and other materials used. 
**Step 4:** After successful completion of the tubewell/filter point construction work under departmental supervision, the interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the concerned office and request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the concerned authority:

- **Puducherry:** Office of the Hydrogeologist‐II, State Ground Water Unit & Soil Conservation, Thattanchavady, Puducherry‐9.- **Karaikal:** Office of the Additional Director of Agriculture, Karaikal.
**Step 5:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 6:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form and the documents to the aforementioned authority.

**Step 7:** On receipt of the application, necessary entries will be made in the application receipt register and a unique seniority number will be assigned to the applicant for identifying each applicant which shall be used for all further references and also as acknowledgement for the receipt of the application will be issued to the applicant. 
****The application should be submitted within 90 days from the date of completion of the tubewell/filter point construction work.***

Section: Documents Required
- Aadhaar card of the applicant

Scheme: Tirth Barat Yojana
Section: Application Process
Mode: Offline
Steps:
- The concerned beneficiaries will submit their application forms in the prescribed format to Gram Panchayat/District Panchayat/Deputy Director, Panchayat and Social Welfare of their respective District.

**Note 1:** The selection of beneficiaries from the received applications will be done through a lottery system conducted by the Collector.
**Note 2:** If the name of any of the disabled applicant's spouse is selected, then his/her life partner will also be able to go on the journey, at the time of applying, the applicant will have to attach the application of the life partner along with the applicant's application.
**Note 3:** Five or more disabled people will also be able to apply as a group. The entire group will be considered as one application and will be included in the lottery. It will be mandatory for every disabled pilgrim to be accompanied by an assistant on the pilgrimage. The assistant should be close to the disabled person or someone of his choice.

**Note 4:** A person above 65 years of age, who has applied to travel alone, will be eligible to take one assistant with him on the journey. On application by a group of persons, a group of 3 to 5 persons will be eligible to take 1 assistant along with the said group, provided that every person in this group is above 65 years of age. In large groups, assistants will be recognized at the rate of 1 per 05 passengers. There will be no facility to take an assistant if the spouse is traveling together, provided one of them is below 65 years of age. This will not be applicable in the case of persons with disabilities.

**Note 5:** If the name of any of the applicant's spouse is selected, his/her life partner will also be able to accompany him on the journey. Even if the age of the applicant's life partner is less than 60 years, he/she will be able to travel with the applicant. While applying, the applicant will have to mention that his/her life partner is also willing to travel with him/her. In such a situation, the application of the said life partner will also have to be attached with the applicant's application. If there is eligibility to take an assistant along with him on the journey, then the application of that assistant will also be submitted along with the applicant. This will not be applicable in case of persons with disabilities.

**Note 6:** If a group of individuals apply together, the entire group will be considered as one application and included in the lottery. The said group can be of a maximum of 25 applicants. One applicant of the group will be called the head of the group. Applications of all other applicants will be submitted attached with his/her application. If the persons included in the said group are eligible to take helpers, then the applications of the proposed helpers will also be attached with this application. The number of people included in the group, including assistants, will not exceed 25. This will not be applicable in case of persons with disabilities.

**Note 7:** The envelope in which the application form is to be sent should be prescribed as “Application for a visit to the place under Mukhyamantri Teerth Yatra Yojana Year -----, the year in which the pilgrimage place is being applied for. That should be mentioned.
**Note 8:** The applicant will also have to mention the names and other particulars of any two nominees with whom they can be contacted immediately in case of any emergency, in the prescribed space in the application form. It will be necessary to provide the mobile number of at least one of your nominees.

Scheme: Mukhyamantri Shramshakti Yojana
Section: Application Process
Mode: Online
Steps:
Eligible candidates from minority communities interested in applying for various skill development training programs can submit their applications online via the Bihar State Minorities Financial Corporation Limited's website: [https://bsmfc.org/](https://bsmfc.org/)
> **Registration Process:**

**Step 1:** Visit the official website: [https://bsmfc.org/](https://bsmfc.org/)
**Step 2:** On the homepage, click on the ‘Apply for Skill Training’ link.
**Step 3:** A new page will open; click on ‘Click Here to Apply’
**Step 4:** If you are a new user, click on ‘[New Registration](https://applybsmfc.org/msytra/Register.aspx)’.
**Step 5:** Complete the registration form with all required details and click on the ‘Register’ button.
**Step 6:** A confirmation message will appear. Note down the User ID and Password displayed on the screen.
> **Apply for Scheme:**

**Step 1:** After registration, either continue on the same page or return to the website to [login](https://applybsmfc.org/msytra/Login.aspx).
**Step 2:** Enter your User ID and Password, then click on ‘Login’.
**Step 3:** Provide your personal details, educational qualifications, select the trade for training, and fill in the training details.
**Step 4:** Upload your photograph, signature, and other required documents, then submit the application.
> **Selection process:**

- Shortlisting of applications received for various skill training programs from different districts of the state will be done by the Corporation.
 - In case of receipt of more applications than the prescribed number of seats in the same training program in the same district, preference will be given to applicants with higher qualifications. In case of equal qualification, preference will be given to the applicant with older age.
 - After shortlisting, the list and application form will be sent to the District Minority Welfare Office of the concerned district while allotting the district and training program to the shortlisted applicants.
- The final selection of the applicants will be done by the selection committee constituted under the chairmanship of the Deputy Development Commissioner of the concerned district.

> **Security Deposit:**

 - After final selection for the skill training programme (at the time of enrolment), the selected candidate will have to deposit ₹1,000/- as refundable security deposit, which will be returned to them after successful completion of the training programme.

[User Manual](https://applybsmfc.org/msytra/img/UserManual.pdf)

Scheme: Charmashilpa Scheme

Steps:
> **Registration Process:**

**Step-01:** Visit the official [Seva Sindhu Portal](https://sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in/Sevasindhu/English). 
**Step-02:** Choose "New Users Register Here" and fill in your Aadhaar Number and the Captcha code.

> **Applying for a Scheme:**

**Step-01:** Go to [Seva Sindhu Portal](https://sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in/Sevasindhu/English) and select "Department & Services".
**Step-02:** Select department "Social Welfare Department" and click on the scheme "Charmashilpa Scheme"
**Step-03:** Click "Apply Online" and enter your registered email ID/mobile number and the OTP.
**Step-04:** Select the scheme and provide your personal, address, and banking details as required.
**Step-05:** Once submitted, you will receive an Application ID. You can use this ID to track your application status on the portal.

**Step 2: Pass the eligibility checker**

**Step 2: Pass the eligibility checker**

- After you have clicked on the link to the application portal, answer the eligibility questions to confirm your eligibility for a Chevening Scholarship.
- You will find out immediately if you passed or failed the eligibility checker. If you did not pass but think there was an error, you will be given two more attempts. 
- If you pass the eligibility checker, you will receive an email to your registered email address with a link to continue your application. 

- Tip: Take the eligibility quiz on our website to find out if you will pass the eligibility checker! 

**Step 3: Make a note of your access code**

**Step 3: Make a note of your access code**

- Once you have followed the link in your email to continue your application, you will see an access code displayed on your screen. This access code is unique to you.
- You must make a note or take a photo of your unique access code for your records as you will need it every time you want to access your application.

**Step 4: Complete each section of the application form**

- You will now be able to start your Chevening application. 
- When completing the form, keep in mind that you will be logged out of the system if you are inactive for 15 minutes, so remember to save your progress as you work through each stage! 
- You will need to complete each section of the application form: 

> **Personal Details:******

> **Personal Details:****** 

> Provide your full name, pronouns, date of birth, address, and preferred interview location. 

> **Immigration Details:****** 

> Confirm your country of citizenship, passport number (where available), and other relevant details. 

> **Education History:****** 

> Enter details of your education, including names of institutions attended, courses studied, and results received. You can add up to 15 entries. 

> **Work History:****** 

> You can add up to 15 entries of past work experiences to the application form. 

> The system will then calculate if you meet Chevening’s requirement for 2,800 hours of work experience by multiplying the number of weeks by the number of hours worked for each entry. You will be able to view your total number.

> Find out more about the work experience requirement and the type of work that counts towards it. 

> **Programmes of Study** 

> Submit details of your top three UK master’s degree course choices. You can find a full list of Chevening eligible courses on the course finder. 

> You will be asked if you have already applied to each of your course choices. Please note that it is not a requirement to apply to your course choices before submitting your Chevening application. 

> Read more about preparing your UK university application.

> On your application form will you be asked to submit the names, job details, and contact details of two referees.

> If you are invited to interview, you will need to upload two letters written by your chosen referees to the online application system. 

> Find out more about references. 

> **Essay Questions** 

> Respond to the four Chevening essay questions on leadership, relationship-building, your course choices, and future career goals.

Scheme: Scheme of Post Matric Scholarship to Lower Income Group Student for Studies in India
Section: Application Process
Mode: Online
Steps:
> **Registration**

**Step 1:** Visit the [Official Website](https://harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in/) of the "Centralized Scholarship Portal" of the Department of Higher Education, Haryana.
**Step 2:** In the menu ribbon, click "Student > [Student Registration](https://harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in/StudentRegistration)".
**Step 3:** On the next page, provide your Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID) and click "Search".
_*Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) is mandatory for availing of any Scholarship benefit. Students are advised to ensure their all particulars such as Name, DOB, Aadhar No. etc are fully updated in PPP before applying for any scholarship scheme._

**Step 4:** A List of the members of your family will be displayed. Select the checkbox against your name and click "Generate OTP". Enter the OTP received on your registered Mobile Number and click on "Verify OTP".
**Step 5:** After OTP verification, you will be taken to the registration page. In the registration form, all the mandatory fields get auto-filled. You only need to cross-check the information.
**Step 6:** Select your Department and College. Create a Password and click "Register".
> **Application**

**Step 1:** Visit the [Official Website](https://harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in/) of the "Centralized Scholarship Portal" of the Department of Higher Education, Haryana.
**Step 2:** In the right corner of the menu ribbon, click "[User Login](https://harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in/UserLogin)". Use the username and password created during your registration to log in.
**Step 3:** Navigate to the online form of the scheme you intend to apply for. In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections.
**Step 4:** Click "Apply" to submit your application. You'll receive a confirmation message.

**Step 1:** Farmers should register themselves on the [Meri Fasal, Mera Byora Portal](https://fasal.haryana.gov.in/) during the sowing period. It is mandatory for the farmer to avail the benefits under this scheme.
**Step 2:** On the homepage, click the link for "Farmer Registration (Kisan Panjikaran)."
**Step 3:** Go through the guidelines and click on "Proceed for Registration."
**Step 4:** Complete the form by entering all the required details accurately.
**Step 5:** After verifying the entered details, click on "Submit for Registration." Upon successful registration, the farmer will receive a username and password for portal access.
**Note 1:** Free registration of producer.

**Note 1:** Free registration of producer.
**Note 2:** Registration will be open only during the stipulated period.
**Note 3:** Registration facility will be available at Sarva Seva Kendra/e-Disha Kendra/ Marketing Board/Horticulture Department/ Agriculture Department and Internet Kiosk.
***Steps to Make Claims and Check Status:***

- **Login to e-Kharid Portal:** Visit the [e-Kharid login](https://ekharid.in/Account/LogIn#no-back-button) page, enter your username, password, and the captcha code. - **Access the Dashboard:** Once logged in, farmers can make claims and track the status of their applications or complaints.
***J-Form - Sale Voucher:***
To receive compensation under the scheme:

- Sale on J-Form will be mandatory for Incentive.
 - The "J-Form," a sale voucher, must be obtained upon selling the produce.

 - Incentive will be payable by multiplying the difference in price.

Scheme: Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana
Question: What is the Bhavantar Bharpayee Yojana (BBY)?

Answer: Fishermen need a valid diesel card, a boat registration certificate, and identification proof such as an Aadhaar Card or Fishermen ID. Additional documents may required as per the authority along with the above-mentioned documents.

Scheme: Intensive Castration Scheme
Section: Documents Required
- Copy of barcoded ration card or Institute’s registration number.
- Copy of government-issued photo identification (Aadhaar card/ Voter ID/ Driving License/ Kisan Credit Card).
- Copy of bank passbook or cancelled cheque.

Scheme: Intensive Castration Scheme
Section: Application Process
Mode: Online
Steps:
**Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at I-Khedut Portal: [https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/)
**Step 2:** On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Animal Husbandry Schemes’.
**Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button and an application page will open.
**Step 4:** Click on "Apply New" button and submit a new application.
**Step 5:** Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application.
**Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it.
**Step 7:** Take a print out of the confirmed application and submit Related Documents through to concern Taluka office.

> **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx).

Scheme: Intensive Castration Scheme
Question: What is the objective of the "Intensive Castration Scheme"?
Answer: The "Intensive Castration Scheme" supports livestock owners and animal-rearing organizations in castrating male calves through the close method (Burdizo Castrator) or open method (Surgical Method).

Scheme: Intensive Castration Scheme
Question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
Answer: Any individual livestock owner or registered animal-rearing organization, such as Gaushalas or Panjarapols, is eligible to apply for the scheme.

Scheme: Intensive Castration Scheme
Question: What financial assistance is provided under the scheme?
Answer: The scheme provides a subsidy of ₹500/- per male calf for castration.

Scheme: Intensive Castration Scheme
Question: What are the approved methods of castration under this scheme?
Answer: The scheme allows castration through the Burdizo Castrator (close method) and the Surgical Method (open method).

Scheme: Intensive Castration Scheme
Question: Can an applicant avail of the scheme benefits if the male calf has already been castrated?
Answer: No, only male calves that require castration are eligible for the scheme benefits.

Scheme: Intensive Castration Scheme
Question: Where should applicants submit their applications for the scheme?
Answer: All applications must be submitted online through the [I-Khedut](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/) Portal.

Scheme: Intensive Castration Scheme
Question: What documents must be submitted along with the application?
Answer: Applicants must submit a barcoded ration card or Institute’s registration number, a government-issued photo ID, and a bank passbook or a canceled cheque.

Scheme: Intensive Castration Scheme
Question: Where can applicants seek further assistance or clarification regarding the scheme?
Answer: Applicants can contact their local District Veterinary Polyclinic or visit the [I-Khedut](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx) Portal for more details.

Scheme: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
Section: Documents Required
- Identity proof
- Caste Certificate
- Income Certificate
- Residence Certificate
- Educational Qualification Certificates
- Age Proof (Birth Certificate/School Certificate)
- Recent Passport-size Photograph
- Any other documents as required

Step 3: Complete the registration form by providing details such as name, date of birth, gender, parents' details, Aadhaar card number, mobile number, etc.
Step 4: Enter the captcha code and set a password.
Step 5: Upon successful registration, the applicant will receive a User ID and password.
***Login & Application Process:***
Step 1: Log in using the provided User ID and password to access the application form.
Step 2: Click on "Personal Details" and "Education Details.

Step 2: Click on "Personal Details" and "Education Details.
Step 3: Enter Aadhaar card details, address proof, and qualification details, then click "Save & Next.
Step 4: Upload the required documents, including a photograph and signature, Birth certificate, Caste certificate, Income certificate, and Residential certificate.
Step 5: Click "Next" and enter the advertisement number along with details of three schools. Click "Save & Next."

- Accept the Terms & Conditions and click on "Final Submit."
- Upon submission, the applicant will receive an application number.

***Track Application Status:***

- Visit the [official website](https://bcebconline.bihar.gov.in/schoolmis/Default.aspx) for admit card receipt, examination date, result publication, admission, commencement of classes.

Scheme: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
Section: Application Process
Mode: Offline
Steps:
***Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the application form from the [official website](https://bcebconline.bihar.gov.in/schoolmis/Default.aspx). 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the respective District Backward and Extremely Backward Classes Welfare Office.

**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the respective District Backward and Extremely Backward Classes Welfare Office to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).
***Entrance Process:***

- The applicant appears for the objective-type entrance examination.
- If selected, complete the admission formalities at the respective school.

Scheme: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
Question: Who is eligible for admission?
Answer: Girls belonging to BC and EBC categories, residents of Bihar, within the prescribed age limits, and whose parents' annual income does not exceed ₹3,00,000.

Scheme: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
Question: Is there any fee for the entrance exam or admission?
Answer: No, the entrance exam and admission process are completely free.

Scheme: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
Question: What facilities are provided under the scheme?
Answer: Free education, accommodation, food, books, medical care, vocational training, digital study centers, and career guidance sessions.

Scheme: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
Question: How is the selection done?
Answer: Selection is based on an objective-type entrance exam covering Hindi, English, Mathematics, Science, and Social Science.

Scheme: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
Question: What is the duration of the entrance exam?
Answer: The entrance exam is of 100 marks and lasts for two hours.

Scheme: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
Question: What happens if I lose my admit card?
Answer: The applicant can re-download it from the portal or collect a copy from the district welfare office.

Scheme: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
Question: What is the syllabus for the entrance exam?
Answer: The exam includes questions from Hindi, English, Mathematics, Science, and Social Science (20 marks each).

Scheme: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
Question: What is the deadline for applying?
Answer: The application deadline will be announced on the official portal.

Scheme: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
Question: How can I apply for admission?
Answer: Applications can be submitted online on the [official website](https://bcebconline.bihar.gov.in/schoolmis/Default.aspx) or by submitting a printed application to the district welfare office.

Scheme: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
Question: Where can I get more information?
Answer: Visit [bcecebonline.bihar.gov.in](https://bcebconline.bihar.gov.in/schoolmis/Default.aspx) or contact your district welfare office.

Scheme: Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State
Section: Documents Required
- The details of the documents required along with the application form are specified on pages 13 to 17 of the Uttar Pradesh Freedom Fighters and their Families Grant and Freedom Pension Rules, 1975 (as applicable in Uttarakhand).

Scheme: Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State
Section: Application Process
Mode: Offline
Steps:
- Freedom Fighters and their widows are required to obtain the application form from the office of the District Magistrate.
 - The list of documents to be submitted along with the application form is specified in pages 13 to 17 of the Uttar Pradesh Freedom Fighters and their Families Grant and Freedom Pension Rules, 1975 (as applicable in Uttarakhand). 
 - After attaching the required documents, the completed application must be submitted to the District Magistrate. Following verification by the District Magistrate and based on their report/recommendation, the case is forwarded for approval by the Hon’ble Departmental Minister/Hon’ble Chief Minister.
- Once the approval is granted at the Government level, the pension is sanctioned and disbursed to the beneficiary.

Scheme: Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State
Question: Who is eligible for this pension?
Answer: Only recognized freedom fighters domiciled in Uttarakhand and the widows of deceased recognized freedom fighters are eligible.

Scheme: Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State
Question: How much pension is provided under this scheme?
Answer: A monthly/family pension of ₹25,000/- is provided to eligible beneficiaries.

Scheme: Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State
Question: Is this pension available to family members other than widows?
Answer: No.

Scheme: Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State
Question: What is the domicile requirement for applicants?
Answer: The applicant must be a permanent resident (domicile) of Uttarakhand.

Scheme: Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State
Question: Where can applicants obtain the application form?
Answer: The application form can be obtained from the office of the District Magistrate (DM) of the concerned district.

Scheme: Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State
Question: What documents are required to apply for the pension?
Answer: The list of required documents is prescribed in pages 13 to 17 of the Uttar Pradesh Freedom Fighters and their Families Grant and Freedom Pension Rules, 1975 (as applicable in Uttarakhand).

Scheme: Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State
Question: Where should the completed application be submitted?
Answer: The completed application, along with required documents, should be submitted to the District Magistrate of the applicant’s district.

Scheme: Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State
Question: Who sanctions the pension finally?
Answer: The pension is sanctioned at the Government level after approval by the Hon’ble Departmental Minister/Hon’ble Chief Minister.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Section: Documents Required
- Birth Certificate.
- Residence Certificate issued by the Mamlatdar.
- Aadhaar Card.
- Valid Driving License Number.
- Experience Certificate from Editor/Head of Organisation.
- Latest Payslip from the Organisation.
- Quotation from a Reputed Dealer.
- Purchased Documents for the E-bike.
- Bank Details.
- Two Passport Size Photographs.
- Declaration.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Section: Application Process
Mode: Offline
Steps:
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://dip.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/notification-e-v-bike.pdf) of the application form. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and enclose the copies of all the mandatory documents (endorsed, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the Director, Department of Information and Publicity, Udyog Bhavan, 3rd floor, Panaji.
> **Post-Application Processes**

**Step 1:** After approval of the application, the Beneficiary will have to provide purchased documents (Registration Certificate book and insurance) along with bank details to release the subsidy directly to the beneficiary.
**Step 2:** The Screening Committee, constituted under the Chairmanship of the Director of Information and Publicity, will scrutinize/sanction applications and may ask for additional documents if required.
**Step 3:** The subsidy will be disbursed in a single instalment upon purchase of the vehicle and production of the necessary documents.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: Is there an age limit for journalists to qualify for the subsidy?
Answer: Yes, the beneficiary must not be more than 58 years old at the time of application.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: Can journalists who have availed similar benefits under other government schemes apply?
Answer: No, applicants who have already benefited from any other government scheme for e-bikes are not eligible.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: What proof of employment is required for the subsidy application?
Answer: A letter from the Editor or Head of the Organization confirming the applicant’s employment as a journalist for at least 8 years is mandatory.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: How much subsidy will be provided for the purchase of an e-bike?
Answer: The subsidy covers 50% of the e-bike’s price or a maximum of ₹50,000, whichever is lower.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: Are part-time journalists eligible to apply for the subsidy?
Answer: No, only full-time journalists whose sole livelihood depends on journalistic activities qualify for the subsidy.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: How many e-bikes will be subsidized under this scheme annually?
Answer: The government will grant subsidies for 65 e-bikes each year, allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: Can journalists working for electronic media organizations apply for the subsidy?
Answer: Yes, journalists working for both print and electronic media organizations are eligible if they meet the other criteria.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: Is there a limit on the number of beneficiaries per media organization?
Answer: Yes, a maximum of two beneficiaries per media organization will be considered per meeting.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: Who constitutes the committee responsible for scrutinizing and approving applications?
Answer: The committee includes the Director of Information and Publicity, Presidents of journalist associations, and a representative from the Finance Department.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: Can the subsidy be used to purchase any type of e-bike?
Answer: The type and cost of the e-bike will be decided by the government, and applicants must submit a quotation from a reputed dealer.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: What is the validity period of the scheme before it is reviewed?
Answer: The scheme will be reviewed after 3 years from its commencement date.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: Are retired journalists eligible to apply for the subsidy?
Answer: No, only working journalists who meet the age and employment criteria are eligible.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: What is the role of the Mamlatdar in the application process?
Answer: The Mamlatdar issues the 15-year residence certificate, which is a mandatory document for proving domicile in Goa.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: Can journalists who engage in other professions alongside journalism apply?
Answer: No, applicants must not engage in any other activity and must rely solely on journalism for their livelihood.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: Is there a relaxation clause for any of the eligibility conditions?
Answer: The government may relax certain conditions on a case-by-case basis, except those related to financial benefits.

Scheme: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
Question: How is the subsidy amount calculated if the e-bike’s price exceeds ₹1,00,000?
Answer: The subsidy will be 50% of the price or ₹50,000, whichever is lower, regardless of the e-bike’s total cost.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Section: Documents Required
- Proof of Working in an Established Newspaper/periodical Magazine for at Least Three Years (Certificate From Employer).
- Birth Certificate or Proof of Working in Goa for Three Years.
- Declaration Stating No Financial Assistance Has Been Availed From Other Government Schemes.
- Original Bills and Photocopies of Hospital/institution Documents (for Medical Claims).
- Doctor's Certificate for Specific Treatments (if Applicable).
- Recommendation Letters From Two Persons/institutions With Technical Knowledge of the Applicant's Work.
- Attested Copy of Birth Certificate.
- Details of Dependents (Name, Age, Relationship, Occupation, Income).

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Section: Application Process
Mode: Offline
Steps:
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should take print of the [prescribed format](https://dip.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/The-Patrakarb-Kritadnyata-Nidhi-Scheme.pdf) of the application form.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the Director of Information and Publicity, Government of Goa.
> **Post-Application Processes**

**Step 1:** The Director will scrutinize the application and forward it to the Sub-Committee for review. The Sub-Committee will decide the quantum of assistance and seek government approval.
**Step 2:** Once approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed via cheque to the eligible applicant.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: Can journalists engaged in other professions apply for financial assistance under this scheme?
Answer: No, journalists engaged in any other profession besides journalism are not eligible to apply for financial assistance under this scheme.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: What proof is required to establish that a journalist has worked in Goa for three years?
Answer: A certificate from the employer confirming continuous employment for at least three years in a newspaper or periodical magazine must be submitted along with the application.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: Is there any annual renewal requirement for registered journalists under this scheme?
Answer: Yes, journalists registered under this scheme must renew their registration by June 30th every year to remain eligible for benefits.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: Are journalists who have availed benefits from other government schemes eligible for this assistance?
Answer: No, journalists who have already received benefits from other government schemes for the same purpose (e.g., Kanyadan, Mediclaim) are ineligible.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: What types of emergencies are covered under this financial assistance scheme?
Answer: The scheme covers expenses for marriage of a daughter, medical treatment, funeral costs, travel for treatment, scholarships, self-employment, house repairs, and lump-sum death grants.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: What is the maximum financial assistance provided for medical treatment under this scheme?
Answer: The maximum assistance for medical treatment, including super-specialty care, is ₹2,00,000/-, provided original bills are submitted within three months.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: Can financial assistance be provided for the marriage of a journalist’s daughter?
Answer: Yes, the scheme provides up to ₹2,00,000/- to cover marriage expenses of a journalist’s daughter, subject to eligibility.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: Is there any provision for funeral expenses under this scheme?
Answer: Yes, the scheme provides up to ₹2,00,000/- to cover funeral expenses of a deceased journalist for their next of kin.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: How much financial assistance is available for house repairs due to natural calamities?
Answer: Journalists can receive up to ₹2,00,000/- for house repairs or construction necessitated by natural calamities.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: Who scrutinizes the applications for financial assistance under this scheme?
Answer: The Director of Information and Publicity scrutinizes applications before forwarding them to a Sub-Committee for final approval.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: What is the composition of the Sub-Committee that reviews applications?
Answer: The Sub-Committee includes the Secretary (Information & Publicity), representatives from Goa Union of Journalists, Goa Editors Guild, and the Director of Information & Publicity.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: Can financial assistance be provided for self-employment ventures under this scheme?
Answer: Yes, journalists can receive up to ₹2,00,000/- as financial assistance for starting self-employment ventures.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: Are there any travel-related expenses covered under this scheme?
Answer: Yes, the scheme covers travel and incidental expenses for journalists moving from local hospitals to outstation facilities for treatment, up to ₹2,00,000/-.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: What is the maximum scholarship amount provided for journalists’ wards under this scheme?
Answer: Wards of journalists pursuing higher education can receive scholarships or incentives up to ₹2,00,000/-.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: How is the financial assistance disbursed to eligible applicants?
Answer: All financial assistance is disbursed through cheques after approval from the Sub-Committee and the Government.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: Who is responsible for resolving grievances related to this scheme?
Answer: The Minister of Information and Publicity hears and decides grievances, and their decision is final.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: Is there a deadline for submitting medical bills for reimbursement?
Answer: Yes, bills for super-specialty treatment must be submitted within three months to qualify for reimbursement.

Scheme: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
Question: Can financial assistance be provided for minor medical procedures?
Answer: Yes, the scheme covers both major and minor medical procedures, with financial assistance up to ₹2,00,000/-.

Scheme: Aapki Beti Yojana
Section: Documents Required
- Passport size photo of the applicant
- Identity proof of applicant
- Educational Certificates
- BPL Certificate
- Death Certificate of Parent(s)
- Jan Aadhaar Card of Family Head or the Girl
- Bank Account Passbook linked with Jan Aadhaar
- Any Other Document if Required

Scheme: Aapki Beti Yojana
Section: Application Process
Mode: Online
Steps:
> ***To avail of the benefits of the scheme, the parents/guardians need to contact their respective government school.***

**Data Entry on Shala Darpan Portal:**

- School authorities log in through the [Shala Darpan School Login](https://rajshaladarpan.rajasthan.gov.in/SD2/BSP/Home/HomePage.aspx).- Navigate to the "Student" tab and fill required details in Form-9.

**Category Selection for Eligible Girls:**

- Under the “Mandatory Student Information for Beneficiary Schemes” section, select class-wise eligible girls under “BPL” and “Orphan/Single Parent” categories.

**Beneficiary Approval:**

**Beneficiary Approval:**

- Visit the Beneficiary Scheme Portal through School Login.
- Select the appropriate scheme and approve and lock the displayed list of eligible girls.

**Verification by District Education Officer (DEO):**

- Locked data is reflected on the DEO (primary/secondary) office login.
- DEO completes final verification using OTP-based approval.

**Jan Aadhaar Verification:**

- Before submission, ensure that the girl’s Jan Aadhaar is verified on the Shala Darpan Portal, as funds are transferred via DBT.

Scheme: Aapki Beti Yojana
Question: Who is eligible to apply under the scheme?
Answer: Girls from BPL families studying in government schools (classes 1st to 12th) who have lost one or both parents are eligible.

Scheme: Aapki Beti Yojana
Question: What is the amount of financial aid provided?
Answer: ₹2,100 for classes 1st to 8th and ₹2,500 for classes 9th to 12th annually.

Scheme: Aapki Beti Yojana
Question: How is the amount disbursed?
Answer: The amount is transferred directly to the Jan Aadhaar-linked bank account of the family head or the girl.

Scheme: Aapki Beti Yojana
Question: Do students studying in private schools qualify for this scheme?
Answer: No, only students studying in government schools are eligible.

Scheme: Aapki Beti Yojana
Question: Is re-application required every year?
Answer: Yes, the application must be submitted each academic year.

Scheme: Aapki Beti Yojana
Question: Can a student with an unverified Jan Aadhaar apply?
Answer: No, Jan Aadhaar must be verified for the application to be processed.

Scheme: Aapki Beti Yojana
Question: How does the school submit data on the portal?
Answer: Schools use Shala Darpan Login and follow the structured steps to submit Form-9 and approve beneficiaries.

Scheme: Aapki Beti Yojana
Question: What is the role of the Beneficiary Scheme Portal?
Answer: It is used for viewing, approving, locking, and submitting the beneficiary list.

Scheme: Aapki Beti Yojana
Question: Is a death certificate mandatory?
Answer: Yes, the death certificate of the deceased parent(s) is required.

Scheme: Aapki Beti Yojana
Question: Can Jan Aadhaar be in the name of the girl herself?
Answer: Yes, the Jan Aadhaar can be in the name of the girl or the family head.

Scheme: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
Section: Documents Required
- Colour Prints in 12x13 Size, Mounted.
- Soft Copy of High-resolution Photographs.
- Author Details: Name, Nationality, Postal Address, Mobile Number, Telephone Number, and Email Address (Written on the Back of Photographs in Block Letters).
- Technical Details of the Camera Used.
- Brief Description of Each Photograph (Not More Than 50 Words).
- Bio-data of the Photographer (Not More Than 100 Words).
- Certificate of Originality (Declaring Photographs as Original Work).
- Latest Residence Certificate (as Proof of Eligibility).
- *Mobile Images Are Not Accepted.

Scheme: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
Section: Application Process
Mode: Offline
Steps:
The interested individuals should send their entries along with the required documents and details to the "Director of Information & Publicity, 3rd Floor, Udyog Bhavan, Panaji, Goa", superscribing the envelope as “Entries for The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition”. A soft copy of high-resolution photographs will also be required to be submitted.

Scheme: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
Question: What are the two categories for the photo contest and what topics do they cover?
Answer: The first category is "Unknown Tourist Spot in Goa," and the second category is "Promoting Self Employment to sustain livelihood."

Scheme: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
Question: What personal details must be included on the back of each submitted photograph?
Answer: The photographer’s name, nationality, postal address, mobile/telephone numbers, and email address must be written in block letters on the back of each photograph.

Scheme: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
Question: Are mobile phone images acceptable for submission in the contest?
Answer: No, mobile phone images will not be considered for entry in the contest.

Scheme: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
Question: What technical details about the photograph must accompany the submission?
Answer: The entrant must provide details such as the camera used along with the photograph submission.

Scheme: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
Question: Is there a word limit for the brief description of the photograph and the photographer’s bio-data?
Answer: Yes, the brief description of the photograph and the photographer’s bio-data must not exceed 100 words each.

Scheme: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
Question: What certification is required to confirm the originality of the submitted photographs?
Answer: The entrant must provide a certificate stating that all photographs are original works taken by the entrant themselves.

Scheme: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
Question: Are soft copies of the photographs required for submission?
Answer: Yes, entrants must submit a soft copy along with a high-resolution version of the photograph.

Scheme: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
Question: What are the size and color requirements for the printed photographs?
Answer: Entrants must submit color prints in 12 x 8 size for the contest.

Scheme: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
Question: How many photographs can an entrant submit for the contest?
Answer: An entrant can submit a maximum of 4 different photographs, either in one or both categories.

Scheme: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
Question: Is there an entry fee or age restriction for participating in the contest?
Answer: No, there is no entry fee, age bar, or qualification required for participation.

Scheme: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
Question: Are photographs taken using drones eligible for submission?
Answer: No, pictures shot with drones will not be accepted in the contest.

Scheme: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
Question: What are the cash prizes for the first, second, and third prizes in each category?
Answer: The first prize is ₹20,000, the second prize is ₹16,000, and the third prize is ₹12,000 in each category.

Scheme: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
Question: Are there any consolation prizes, and what is their value?
Answer: Yes, there are five consolation prizes of ₹2,000 each in each category.

Scheme: Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole
Question: What is the objective of the "Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole" scheme?
Answer: The primary objective of the scheme is to safeguard and promote the preservation of indigenous cow breeds while simultaneously encouraging the production and usage of Panchagavya-based products by extending financial and infrastructural support to Gaushalas and Panjrapoles for their overall upgradation.

Scheme: Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole
Question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
Answer: Only those Gaushalas and Panjrapoles that are formally registered under the Public Charity Act and possess adequate livestock and a suitable amount of land are considered eligible to apply for the benefits provided under this scheme.

Scheme: Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole
Question: What kind of support is provided under the scheme?
Answer: The scheme offers financial assistance that covers up to 75% of the total expenditure incurred on approved components, subject to a maximum cap of ₹4,00,000/-, specifically for the procurement and installation of sanctioned equipment.

Scheme: Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole
Question: Can individuals apply for this scheme?
Answer: No, only registered Gaushalas and Panjrapoles can apply for this scheme.

Scheme: Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole
Question: Is there any minimum livestock requirement?
Answer: Yes, the scheme mandates that eligible Gaushalas must have more than 50 indigenous cows, while Panjrapoles are required to maintain a livestock population of more than 100 animals to qualify for assistance.

Scheme: Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole
Question: Is owning land mandatory?
Answer: Yes, it is mandatory for institutions to possess at least 3 acres of land, either through ownership or on a lease basis for a minimum of 99 years, in order to be considered eligible for the scheme.

Scheme: Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole
Question: How often can benefits be reclaimed?
Answer: Institutions that have already availed benefits for certain components under the scheme can apply for the same components again only after the completion of a minimum duration of one year from the date of the last availed benefit.

Scheme: Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole
Question: Is there any upper limit on land size?
Answer: There is no specified upper limit on the size of land that an institution can possess, meaning institutions with larger land holdings are equally eligible, provided they meet the minimum land criteria.

Scheme: Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole
Question: Where can eligible institutions apply for the scheme?
Answer: Applications must be submitted online through the iKhedut portal, followed by submission of printed applications with signatures and required documents to the board.

Scheme: Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole
Question: Within how many days must the application documents be submitted?
Answer: The documents must be submitted to the board within 30 days of submitting the online application.

- Data is entered on PCTS portal during antenatal checkups and post-institutional delivery.
- DBT is done automatically by the Department of Medical, Health & Family Welfare.

**For Second Installment:**

**For Second Installment:**

You will be taken to the Registration Form.

Scheme: State Art Exhibition Competition
Question: What is the main purpose of the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition”
Answer: The scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition” has been introduced to inspire, promote, and provide recognition to artists, students of art institutions, and school children across Gujarat by encouraging participation in fine arts and offering awards and exhibition opportunities to deserving talents.

Scheme: State Art Exhibition Competition
Question: Who is eligible to participate in the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition”?
Answer: The scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition” is open to three categories of participants: individual artists residing in Gujarat, students currently enrolled in recognized art institutions within the state, and school children studying in Classes 1 to 10 in schools located in Gujarat.

Scheme: State Art Exhibition Competition
Question: What kind of artworks are accepted under the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition”?
Answer: The scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition” accepts creative submissions in various fields of fine arts including painting, sculpture, graphic arts, applied arts, and visual arts from eligible participants, allowing a wide range of artistic expression.

Scheme: State Art Exhibition Competition
Question: How many entries can each participant or institution submit to the competition?
Answer: Under the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition,” each individual artist and each student of an art institution may submit a maximum of two entries, while each school may submit up to 14 entries from students in Classes 1 to 5 and another 14 entries from Classes 6 to 10 through the school’s official process.

Scheme: State Art Exhibition Competition
Question: What is the total value of the prizes awarded through the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition”?
Answer: The scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition” distributes a total of 89 prizes with a combined value of ₹2,47,500, divided among artists, art institution students, and school children as a means of recognizing excellence in artistic creation.

Scheme: State Art Exhibition Competition
Question: How are the winners selected in the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition”?
Answer: In the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition,” all submitted artworks are assessed and judged by panels comprising field-specific experts who select winners based on artistic merit, originality, and overall quality of the work.

Scheme: State Art Exhibition Competition
Question: What are the different prize categories under the scheme?
Answer: The scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition” provides 23 prizes worth ₹1,74,500 in the artist category, 16 prizes worth ₹48,000 in the art institution student category, and 50 prizes worth ₹25,000 in the school children category.

Scheme: State Art Exhibition Competition
Question: Is there any additional benefit for winning students of art institutions in the scheme?
Answer: Yes, in addition to prize money, students of art institutions who win under the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition” are also eligible to receive a monthly scholarship of ₹1,000 funded from the interest earned on a dedicated corpus fund.

Scheme: State Art Exhibition Competition
Question: What type of recognition do the winners of the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition” receive?
Answer: The winners of the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition” receive cash prizes, certificates of merit, an opportunity to showcase their artworks in a dedicated exhibition, and inclusion in a catalogue featuring the prize-winning entries.

Scheme: State Art Exhibition Competition
Question: Where is the exhibition of selected artworks organized?
Answer: Under the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition,” the selected and winning entries are exhibited at the art gallery located in Ravi Shankar Rawal Kala Bhavan, providing public exposure and recognition to the artists.

Scheme: State Art Exhibition Competition
Question: How are participants informed about the call for entries for this scheme?
Answer: The call for entries under the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition” is made public through paid advertisements in daily newspapers, inviting eligible participants to submit their artworks in the prescribed format.

Scheme: State Art Exhibition Competition
Question: Are participants from outside Gujarat eligible to apply for the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition”?
Answer: No, the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition” is exclusively intended for participants who are residents of Gujarat, and individuals from outside the state are not eligible to apply.

Scheme: State Art Exhibition Competition
Question: How are the prize funds of the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition” sourced?
Answer: The prize funds for the scheme “State Art Exhibition Competition” are partially provided by the Gujarat State Fine Arts Academy and partially from the interest accrued on donations made by eminent artists and well-wishers of the fine arts community.

Scheme: Pashupalan (GBCDC)
Section: Application Process
Mode: Online
Steps:
**Step 1: Visit the Official Website:** Go to the [[Official Website](https://ggdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) Gujarat Backwards Caste Development Corporation.](https://gbcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/)
**Step 2: Locate and Apply for Scheme:** Scroll down on the homepage, find the "Pashupalan," and click on "Apply Now".
**Step 3:** **Access Application Form:** You will be directed to the [application form](https://gbcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/SchemePasupalan/AddEdit). 
**Step 4: Scheme Selection & Loan Details:** Select "Pashupalan", enter Unit Cost, and specify the Required Loan Amount.

**Step 5: Applicant's Details:** Provide Aadhaar, Ration, Voter ID, full name (Last, First, Father/Husband), address, district, taluka, village, PIN, date of birth, age (21-45 as of 14/08/2023), caste, subcaste, phone, mobile, email, gender, and marital status.
**Step 6: Income Details:** Enter income certificate number, issue date, issuing officer's name, total annual family income (up to ₹ 3,00,000/-), and parent/guardian's occupation.
**Step 7: Disability Details (if applicable):** If "Physically Handicapped," select "Yes" or "No". If you selected "Yes", provide the percentage (in %).
**Step 8: Employment Details (if applicable):** Indicate if any family member works in a government or private job. If "Yes," provide their Name, Designation, Place, and Salary details.

**Step 9: Educational Qualification:** Select your Education Qualification: Uneducated, Educated, Graduation, Post Graduation, or Other Degree.
**Step 10: Loan History:** If you have taken a past loan, select "Yes" or "No". If you selected "Yes" provide loan details (date, amount, paid, remaining) and your account number.
**Step 12: Bank Account Details:** Provide bank account number, bank name, branch name, name as per account, account type (Saving/Current), MICR code, and IFSC code.
**Step 13: Submission:** Click the "Submit" button to complete your application.

Navigate to the “How to Apply” section and select “Foreign Study Loan.”- You will be redirected to the [e-SamajKalyan](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/) Portal. On the home page, under the tab ‘Citizen Login’, click on New User ‘[Please Register Here](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/Registration.aspx)’. Enter your Full Name as per Aadhaar Card, Gender, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Card Number, Email ID, Caste etc. and then click on ‘Register’.- Log in using your credentials once registration is complete.

**Step 2: Access and Fill Out the Application Form**

Enter personal, academic, and family information in the respective modules: Name, gender, category, address, educational background, institution details, passport number, family income, occupation of guardians, and bank details (to be used for loan disbursement).
- Use dropdown selections in the "Patrata Column" (પાત્રતાની કોલમ) to correctly indicate your eligibility parameters. It is mandatory to select from the dropdown so that your application is processed under the right criteria.

**Step 3: Prepare and Upload Required Documents**

**Step 3: Prepare and Upload Required Documents**

- Scan and upload clear, legible documents in the upload section. 
- Ensure each file is within the portal’s size and format limitations (usually PDF, JPEG or PNG) and named properly to avoid confusion during review.

**Step 4: Review and Final Submission**

- Carefully review each module. Use the preview option to examine the application before final submission.
- Save a local PDF copy of the completed form for your records. Click “Final Submit”.

**Step 5: Application Verification by GUEEDC**

**Step 5: Application Verification by GUEEDC**

- Upon submission, your application and uploaded documents will be reviewed by GUEEDC officials.
- You may be contacted via phone or email if: Any clarification is required, Additional documents are needed, or Corrections must be made.
- Maintain active communication channels and respond promptly to any such requests.

**Loan Sanction and Disbursement**

- If the application is accepted, a formal sanction letter will be issued.
- You may be asked to sign an agreement accepting the terms and repayment conditions of the loan.
- The sanctioned loan amount will be disbursed directly into your verified bank account.
- If any post-sanction verification or usage confirmation is required, comply as per instructions provided by GUEEDC.
